summary: Three students sit at individual desks with open books. Reader A remains steadily oriented toward his book throughout the video. Reader B reads and turns a page before looking away to her right. Reader C is partially cropped at the top edge of the frame, making gaze and reading state difficult to verify visually.

people.label: Reader A
people.description: Boy in a blue sweater seated at the left foreground desk with an open book.

segments.reason: Maintains a continuous downward head orientation toward his open book and turns a page.

page_turns.reason: Lifts the page on the left side, flips it across, and lets it settle on the right side.

people.label: Reader B
people.description: Girl in an orange long-sleeve top seated at the right foreground desk with an open book.

segments.reason: Looks down at the open book, follows text with her hand, and turns a page.
Sits back and turns her head away from the book, looking toward her right.

page_turns.reason: Lifts the right page with her right hand and turns it over to the left side.

people.label: Reader C
people.description: Person in an orange/red top seated at the background center desk, partially cut off by the upper edge of the frame.

segments.reason: Head and upper face are cut off by the top frame border, preventing clear assessment of head orientation and eye gaze.

page_turns.reason: Visible movement of lifting and turning a sheet from the open book on the desk.
